== Card credits ==
Jake Nelson is credited with the original concept of three Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credits name where the concept was won: MN Superweekend 2010 and North Dakota States 2011. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 7]] (released 2010–2011), [[Virtual Block 8]] (released 2012–2013) and [[Virtual Set 0]] (released 24 September 2014).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-

|-

|-
| [[Vigo (V) (Virtual Block 8)|•••Vigo (V)]] || [[Virtual Block 8]] || 2012–2013 || "Original concept by Jake Nelson, North Dakota States 2011"

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Jake Nelson|Jake Nelson]] on [[Card Credits]].
